# PatchFlow — Autonomous API Reliability & Self-Healing Platform
# https://patchflow.cloud
#
# This file helps AI assistants, answer engines, and LLM-powered search
# understand PatchFlow's purpose, key pages, and documentation.

## What PatchFlow does

PatchFlow is an autonomous dual-engine API reliability platform for backend developers:

**Engine 1 — Chaos Testing (Proactive):**
Stress-tests backend APIs before deployment by auto-discovering endpoints from
OpenAPI specs, Postman collections, or repository source code, then injecting
18+ synthetic failure modes (network latency, database disconnects, malformed
payloads, 503 responses, etc.). Generates a 0–100 reliability score and opens
compiler-verified GitHub Draft Pull Requests with resilience fixes.

**Engine 2 — Production Incident Auto-Patching (Reactive):**
A lightweight SDK (Node.js and Python) captures unhandled production exceptions.
When the same error occurs at the same location 3 or more times, PatchFlow
triggers an AI-powered fix pipeline: it clones the repository, locates the
route handler, generates an AST-compliant error-handling patch, verifies it
compiles cleanly, and opens a Draft Pull Request for developer review.

Supported frameworks: FastAPI, Django/DRF, Express.js, Spring Boot, Flask.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2026
- Website: https://patchflow.cloud
- Status: Live (hosted on Render, PostgreSQL on Aiven)
- Auth: GitHub OAuth only
- Pricing: Free (Hobby), $14/mo (Developer Pro), $42/mo (Team & Business)
- SDK languages: JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, Next.js, Edge), Python
- Fix pipeline: AI model → AST patch → build verification → GitHub Draft PR
- Pull requests are ALWAYS drafts — nothing merges automatically
- Blocklist: auth, billing, payment, credential, and migration files are
  never auto-patched

## SDK quick start

**Node.js:**
```js
// patchflow.js — download from https://patchflow.cloud/sdk/patchflow.js
const patchflow = require('./patchflow');
patchflow.init({ apiKey: process.env.PATCHFLOW_API_KEY });
// Express: app.use(patchflow.expressMiddleware()); after all routes
```

**Python (FastAPI):**
```python
# patchflow.py — download from https://patchflow.cloud/sdk/patchflow.py
import patchflow
patchflow.init(api_key=os.environ["PATCHFLOW_API_KEY"])
```

API ingest endpoint: https://api.patchflow.cloud/api/sdk/errors
SDK documentation: https://patchflow.cloud/docs

## What the SDK sends

- Error type and message (truncated, PII-redacted server-side)
- Stack frames (file, line, function — no request bodies, no cookies, no headers)
- Endpoint path, HTTP method, status code
- Framework name and environment tag
